text:
Alice W: :rotating_light: paging oncall — multiple customer reports of 95th+ tail latency spikes and OOM-like evictions on inference pool 'd-rt-24' since ~08:12 UTC. Observed increased KV cache size and continuous-batch amplification.

Raj S: seeing same in the dashboards, continuous-batcher throughput doubled, latency tail up ~4-6x. Heap pressure on several nodes, GC thrash in logs.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-4587 - kv-cache blowup + speculative-decode interaction. Severity: P1. Paging oncall: @Alice W (@oncall).

Alice W: I'm on it. tagging infra and runtime. @Tom Eng can you join — we might need a quick config rollback if spec-decode is amplifying cache growth.

Tom Eng: joining. quick summary from my side: we rolled continuous-batching increase (max_batch_size=8192 -> 16384) for d-rt-24 at 07:50 to improve throughput for embeddings workload. Speculative decoding was enabled cluster-wide as an experiment. Suspect interaction.

Maria Ops: customer-impact note: 2 enterprise customers in eu-west showing ~20% 5xx spike and degraded p50->p99. Tickets opened by CSMs. No data exfil; just latency/failures.

Emily SRE: logs show repeated entries: `runtime: kv_cache: allocation ballooned to 1.2GB, evicting prefix entries` across multiple GPUs, followed by `spec_decode: mismatch draft/target keys, cache divergence`. That mismatch line correlates with heavy batching windows.

Raj S: also seeing `batcher: continuous_window_ms=40 -> inflight groups overlapping -> duplicate kv writes` in the debug trace. That explains divergence.

Alice W: mitigation plan options: 1) disable speculative decoding cluster-wide (fast toggle) 2) revert max_batch_size to previous 8192 3) reduce continuous_window_ms to 10ms 4) increase kv_cache_ttl/eviction thresholds (but that risks more memory). Recommend option 1 + 2 as immediate.

Tom Eng: agree. Option 1 should stop divergence quickly. I can flip the feature flag.

Jack P: heads-up: disabling spec-decode may increase per-token latency for some low-latency customers but better than OOMs. We'll notify affected product owners.

Alice W: do the toggle. include a canary then roll.

Tom Eng: running hotfix.

Tom Eng (code):
```
# disable speculative decoding via control plane
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN" \
  https://control.internal.redwood/v1/feature-flags/speculative_decode/disable \
  -d '{"scope": "d-rt-24","reason":"incident 2026-4587 - cache divergence"}'
```

deploy-bot: feature-flag update queued for d-rt-24 canary (2 nodes)

Alice W: canary nodes reports — pinging metrics every 30s.

Tom Eng: canary results: spec-decode toggle stopped mismatch logs on both canaries. KV cache growth stabilized and eviction rate dropped by ~80% on canaries.

Maria Ops: CSMs notified that we're applying mitigation, advising customers of degraded tail latency for a short window.

Emily SRE: proceeding with gradual rollout across d-rt-24 (12 nodes). Monitoring p95/p99 and evictions. If we see any regression we rollback the flag.

(15m later)

Emily SRE: rolling out to remaining nodes. p99 trending down cluster-wide. Eviction counts decreased to baseline. No new OOMs.

Raj S: while toggle mitigates, we should revert the batch-size bump as a follow-up — continuous-batch size increase exposed race where overlapping batches wrote inconsistent draft keys.

Tom Eng: I can revert max_batch_size in config service now.

Tom Eng (code):
```
PATCH /config/services/d-rt-24
{
  "continuous_batch.max_size": 8192
}
# via internal config API
```

deploy-bot: config patch applied to pool d-rt-24

Alice W: monitoring after batch-size revert. Also lowering continuous_window_ms to 12ms to reduce overlap.

Tom Eng: applied. Observed hit: throughput dip ~8% but p99 improved significantly.

Jack P: product note: running a short postmortem with customer-impact summary and timeline. Also need to evaluate enabling speculative decoding with stricter guardrails (per-model opt-in and KV write idempotency).

Maria Ops: CSMs want a timeline to share with customers. Timeline so far: 07:50 config bump; 08:12 errors start; 08:18 paging; 08:24 canary toggle; 08:40 full rollout disable; 09:02 batch-size revert completed; 09:30 p99 recovered to normal.

Alice W: current status: mitigation complete, traffic stable, no active OOMs. Keeping incident open for runbook tasks and root cause.

Emily SRE: immediate actions (NEXT):
- keep spec-decode disabled for d-rt-24 until runtime bugfix merged
- run thorough replay tests with continuous batching disabled to repro divergence
- add extra metrics: `kv.write_conflicts`, `spec.key_mismatch_rate`
- add alert alerting on kv cache growth rate > 200MB/min

Tom Eng: longer-term: patch proposal to make KV writes idempotent for speculative drafts, and change batching logic to emit non-overlapping batch boundaries or per-request batch ids. I'll open PR after postmortem.

Raj S: also propose feature-gating speculative decode per-model and per-deployment pool. Some models (short context, small kv) are fine; others not.

Jack P: I'll coordinate customer comms and get sign-off from legal if needed.

Maria Ops: postmortem owners: Alice W (incident commander), Tom Eng (runtime fix), Emily SRE (alerts & observability), Raj S (batcher changes), Jack P (customer comms). Target RCA draft in 72 hours.

oncall-bot: Handing off oncall to Alice W at 10:15 UTC for incident follow-up.

Alice W: taking handoff. leaving a short handoff note: mitigation done, spec-decode disabled on d-rt-24, batch-size reverted, metrics stable. Next: PR for idempotent KV writes, extra alerts, runbook update.

Tom Eng: quick note — I captured a compressed trace and uplinked to the incident workspace: https://internal-board/incidents/INC-2026-4587/trace.gz

Emily SRE: closing the immediate pager. Keeping incident open for RCA tasks. If anything flares up I'll re-alert.

Alice W: thanks everyone. :handshake: adding postmortem template and timeline to the incident doc.

(After action)

Alice W: Postmortem checklist posted, assigning action items. Will circle back when RCA draft ready.

Tom Eng: opened PR #4124 for idempotent-kv-writes and batching boundary changes. marking as WIP.

Raj S: added dashboard panels for `spec.key_mismatch_rate` and `kv.write_conflicts`.

Jack P: sent initial customer comms to CSMs. they pushed to two affected accounts.

Emily SRE: final status update: incident downgraded to SEV-Resolved in 24h after no recurrence. Closing thread after RCA is published.

Alice W: closing notes: root cause — interaction between increased continuous batch window + larger max_batch_size and speculative decoding writes causing duplicate/overlapping draft keys that triggered KV cache divergence and memory amplification, leading to eviction storms and tail latency spikes. Full fix requires runtime idempotency + feature gating.

Alice W: :white_check_mark: incident commander sign-off.
